rules.title: San Francisco Allowable Rent Increase
rules.requirement: Landlords may increase rent by no more than 1.6% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.quotedSpan:
Allowable Rent Increase:
1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental units in San Francisco subject to rent control.
warnings: This page reports the current allowed increase rate but does not state which buildings are covered or exempt; consult S.F. Admin. Code ch. 37 for full coverage details and exemptions.

rules.title: San Francisco Security Deposit Interest Rate
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on security deposits held for tenants at an annual rate of 4.2% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.quotedSpan:
Security Deposit Interest:
4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental units in San Francisco.
warnings: This page reports the interest rate but does not state deposit caps or return rules; consult S.F. Admin. Code ch. 37 for those requirements.

rules.title: San Francisco Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition, Capital Improvement, or Substantial Rehabilitation Evictions
rules.effectiveDateQuote:
Date of Service of Notice of Termination of Tenancy ("Eviction Notice")
3/01/26 – 2/28/27
rules.requirement: When a tenant is evicted for owner or relative move-in, demolition, permanent removal of the unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, the landlord must pay relocation assistance of $8,245 per tenant, up to a maximum of $24,733 per unit, plus an additional $5,497 for each elderly (60+), disabled tenant, or household with minor children, if the eviction notice is served between March 1, 2026 and February 28, 2027.
rules.keyValue: $8,245 per tenant; $24,733 per unit maximum; +$5,497 per elderly/disabled/minor household
rules.quotedSpan:
Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
...
3/01/26 – 2/28/27
$8,245.00
$24,733.00
$5,497.00
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental units in San Francisco subject to just-cause eviction requirements.
warnings: The asterisk refers to California Civil Code § 1947.9 for temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days; this rule applies to those of 20+ days or other covered eviction types.

rules.title: San Francisco Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.effectiveDateQuote:
Date of Service of Notice of Termination of Tenancy ("Eviction Notice")
3/01/26 – 2/28/27
rules.requirement: When a tenant is evicted under the Ellis Act (because the owner withdraws the property from rental housing use), the landlord must pay relocation assistance of $11,110.05 per tenant, up to a maximum of $33,330.13 per unit, plus an additional $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant, if the eviction notice is served between March 1, 2026 and February 28, 2027.
rules.keyValue: $11,110.05 per tenant; $33,330.13 per unit maximum; +$7,443.90 per elderly/disabled tenant
rules.quotedSpan:
Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
...
3/01/26 – 2/28/27
$11,110.05
$33,330.13
$7,443.90
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental units in San Francisco subject to Ellis Act eviction rules.
warnings: Ellis Act eviction relocation payments are higher than other eviction types; the age threshold for additional payment is 62+ here, versus 60+ for other eviction types.

rules.title: San Francisco Relocation Payments for Temporary Displacement Under 20 Days
rules.effectiveDateQuote:
Date of Service of Notice of Termination of Tenancy ("Eviction Notice")
3/01/26 – 2/28/27
rules.requirement: When a tenant is temporarily displaced for less than 20 days (e.g., for capital improvement work), the landlord must pay $446 per tenant per day plus actual moving expenses, if the eviction notice is served between March 1, 2026 and February 28, 2027.
rules.citation: S.F. Rent Ordinance § 37.9C and Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9
rules.quotedSpan:
Relocation payments for temporary displacement for less than 20 days
...
3/01/26 – 2/28/27
$446.00/day (plus actual moving expenses)
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental units in San Francisco.
warnings: This rule applies only to temporary displacements of less than 20 days; longer displacements fall under other relocation payment rules.
